defaultPolicy: Assets are evidence from a real, live site. Do not reuse without licence review; never reproduce real logos, real people's photos or proprietary content.

logo.description: The site's own brand mark and its derivatives (app icon, favicon, touch icon).
logo.licensing: Use the exact supplied file. Never redraw, recolour, or invent a variant.

customer-logo.description: Third-party company logos shown as customer social proof (home logo strip: six firms).
customer-logo.licensing: Real trademarks. A generator must never create or reproduce a real company's logo; use an explicit placeholder.

avatar.description: Photos of real people (customers, team, authors).
avatar.licensing: Real people's likeness. Never generate or reuse a real person's photo; use a neutral placeholder.

icon.description: Small generic UI glyphs (<=48px). Never a company, product or brand mark.
icon.licensing: Generic glyphs may be generated; do not copy a proprietary icon set verbatim.

illustration.description: Generic decorative vector artwork. Never a logo, person or product screenshot.
illustration.licensing: May be regenerated in the same style; do not reproduce the original artwork.

background.description: Decorative full-bleed or masked backdrops (e.g. the memo masthead line-art sweeps).
background.licensing: May be regenerated; do not reuse the original file.

hero-image.description: Large image in the page-opening block.
hero-image.licensing: May be regenerated; do not reproduce real product or customer content.

content-image.description: Generic in-page imagery that is none of the protected kinds below.
content-image.licensing: May be regenerated; never include real customer data, names or proprietary UI.

animation.description: Rive / Lottie animation files that drive canvas animations.
animation.licensing: The site's own animation assets. Reuse only the supplied file; never recreate or imitate it for a different brand.

video.licensing: Reuse only the supplied file; never fabricate footage of real products or people.

font.licensing: Fonts carry their own licence; reuse only as shipped and review the licence before redistribution.

live-embed.description: Live third-party iframes and form endpoints.
live-embed.licensing: Never point generated pages at the original site's live endpoints (forms, widgets).

founder-contact-email.description: A real mailto contact address (e.g. a founder or support email) exposed in page copy.
founder-contact-email.licensing: A real, live inbox. Generated pages must not reuse the original address; use a placeholder.

partner-logo.description: Logos of integration/investor/press partners (none rendered on the measured site: investors and press are text-only).
partner-logo.licensing: Real trademarks. Placeholder or supplied file only; never generated.

author-photo.description: Photo of a named author/byline person (the memo has a byline but no photo on the measured site).
author-photo.licensing: A real person's likeness. Never generate or reuse; use a neutral placeholder.

product-screenshot.description: Screenshots of the real product UI (none on the measured site).
product-screenshot.licensing: Proprietary UI and possibly customer data. Never fabricate a screenshot of the real product.

editorial-illustration.description: Illustration that accompanies editorial copy (none on the measured site).
editorial-illustration.licensing: May be generated in the site's style; must not depict real people or real brand marks.

social-card.description: The Open Graph share image (og-v2.png): composed artwork that embeds the brand mark and the headline.
social-card.licensing: Embeds the brand mark. Reuse the supplied file only; never recreate.

retrievalRule: Roles in genericDecorativeRoles may be retrieved as decoration. Roles in protectedRoles (logos, brand marks, people, product screenshots, live endpoints) are identity or compliance assets: they are retrievable only for a section that names them in its assetRoles, must carry source: placeholder|supplied in a PageSpec, and may never be satisfied by a generic decorative asset.
